enhance.title: Enhance (Upscale)
enhance.no_source: Pick an image to see the resulting size.
enhance.plan_same: {0} × {1} — same size, detail is redrawn only.
enhance.amount_15x_tooltip: Upscales the source to the enhanced resolution first, then redraws at that size. Appends -2::upscaled, blurry:: to the prompt to suppress upscaling artifacts (same as the web UI).
enhance.amount_max_tooltip: Redraws detail at the source resolution, then the server upscales the result to the maximum size (about 3.1 MP). The prompt is left untouched because the client never upscales.
enhance.no_15x_custom: 1.5x only works at the sizes NovelAI has an enhanced resolution for. This source is {0}×{1} — use Max, or enhance an image made at one of: {2}
enhance.no_15x_over_cap: At {0}×{1} the 1.5x result would pass the enhance cap (about 3.1 MP). Use Max — NovelAI's web UI also hides 1.5x at this size.
enhance.no_upscale_left: {0}×{1} is already at the enhance cap, so nothing can grow. The size stays and only detail is redrawn.
enhance.folder_blocked: {0} of the {1} queued images cannot be enhanced with {2} (not a standard resolution, or past the cap). Choose Max, or remove those files and try again.
enhance.strength_tooltip: The web UI's Magnitude — its Magnitude 2 was strength 0.5 with noise 0 in the captures.
enhance.use_metadata_tooltip: Reuses the prompt, sampler and steps stored in the source PNG. The seed is not reused (the web UI also picks a new seed for every enhance).
enhance.folder_empty: No enhanceable images were found in that folder.

It does not apply when the seed is set to "Random" or the prompt contains wildcards or random syntax, since those differ every run.
